references.text: Mentions Aphek as one of the cities in Asher's territory, the same geographical area referred to in Joshua 13:4
Refers to Sidon the Great and Misrephoth-maim, which border the same region with the Sidonites mentioned in Joshua 13:4
Describes Israel's northern boundary as including the land of the Canaanites and the territory of the Amorites
States that Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Sidon, showing that the Sidonite area remained unconquered
Mentions the Sidonites among the peoples left in the land to test Israel
Names the king of Aphek as one of the kings Joshua defeated, the same place as in Joshua 13:4
Describes the borders of the Canaanites and mentions the Sidonites and Amorites as descendants of Canaan
